independent_findings.given: A current confirmed reference scene points to a pinned inner dependency. There is no fixed caption source pin to trigger incidental caption verification.
independent_findings.when: Alter the dependency content without updating its stored contentHash and call productionCheckView.
independent_findings.expected: Reject with integrity failure before returning a view; original canonical input remains unchanged.
independent_findings.actual: productionCheckView returns a derived view without rejecting the corrupt reuse pin; the positive rejects assertion fails.

cause.detail: The helper resolves reuse synchronously without verifyReusePins; verifyProductionSources only verifies fixed caption subjects and not their recursive dependencies.
